tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Text 15.6:1 (light) / 17.4:1 (dark) on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, grouped lists, the pressed/hovered stepper circle, secondary button fill. Light cards add a `hairline` border in `border`; dark cards have none.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, popovers, the pressed row inside a group, the illustration fallback tile, the muscle-map body fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1 px hairlines, todo discs (1.5 px outline), ring and progress tracks, chip outlines. Never a container outline in dark.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and every numeral, on `bg`, `surface` and `surfaceRaised`. Also the ON chip fill in light (label in `bg`).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, row glyphs, chevrons, done set-pills. 5.9:1 on `bg` / 5.4:1 on `surface` in light; about 8:1 / 7:1 in dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single accent: primary pill, active tab, now-marks (disc, dot, ring arc), meta icons. Light is ember (white on it 5.0:1); dark is amber (`onAccent` on it about 10:1). One accent object per screen.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `accent`: white in light, near-black in dark (the amber pill carries dark text).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected and today backgrounds (selected card, selected row), accent chip wells. Never for text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done: done discs (check in `bg`), done set-dots, the success status pill text, plan status done. 4.6:1 on `bg` in light.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a success state (tone `success` card). Decorative only.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive row title and glyph, danger status pill, missed plan days, destructive button text on `dangerSoft`. 6.7:1 on `bg` in light.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill and danger card tint; `danger` text on it reads 5.2:1 (light).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Web keyboard focus ring, 2 px solid, outside the control. 3:1 or better on `bg` and `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Banner shadow colour and the scrim behind sheets (`shadow-overlay`).

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The amber glow behind the dark primary pill (`shadow-glow`) and the dark numeral's text shadow (radius 24). Fully transparent in light: nothing glows on paper.

families.display: "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", Impact, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.text: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The one dominant number: stepper value, rest clock, Best-set hero. Tabular figures. Dark adds the `glow` text shadow.

styles.name: numeralLg
styles.usage: Desktop (>= 900) hero numeral only: ExercisePage weight/reps, the Player clock at 280 ring.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: Player clock inside the 220 ring. Tabular.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Exercise name (Today, Library detail), the sign-in title.

styles.name: title2
styles.usage: Section titles inside a screen, card headlines.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row titles, button labels, stat values.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Row subtitles, trailing values (tabular), the AppBar counter.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Units next to a numeral ("kg"), chip labels, status pills, eyebrows, stat labels. Muted unless it is the accent eyebrow.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Inside a chip, between pill marks and a disc and its label; thumb-row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding, label -> its group (`rhythm.labelToGroup`), chip rows apart, status pill horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Gap between a leading glyph/disc and the row title; chip horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Phone gutter, card inner padding, row horizontal padding, gap between StatRow slots.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Group -> next label (`rhythm.groupToLabel`), hero -> first section, button horizontal padding, tablet gutter.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter (`gutter.desktop`), Player control gap.

tokens.name: space-xxxl
tokens.usage: Empty-state top margin; nothing smaller than a screen uses it.

tokens.name: gutter-phone
tokens.usage: Screen edge padding below 600 px.

tokens.name: gutter-tablet
tokens.usage: Screen edge padding 600-899 px.

tokens.name: gutter-desktop
tokens.usage: Screen edge padding from 900 px; page = min(window - 64, 1360).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tiny tiles, the segment-bar ends (2 px) excepted.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, sheets, segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and grouped lists; pair with `borderCurve: continuous`.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, pills, steppers, discs, dots, the primary button: every capsule.

stroke.note: Line weights; `stroke-hairline` is the only container border, and only in light.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Separators, light-theme card borders, chip outlines, in `border`.

tokens.name: stroke-outline
tokens.usage: Todo discs and the selected card border.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Icon stroke on the 24 grid; active tab icon.

tokens.name: stroke-icon-thin
tokens.usage: Inactive tab icon stroke.

tokens.name: stroke-stepper-glyph
tokens.usage: The +/- glyph inside a stepper button (heavier than an icon).

sizes.note: Control, icon, ring and illustration sizes plus the two breakpoints (apps/mobile/src/ui/tokens.ts `sizes`, `breakpoints`).

tokens.name: size-tap
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target; the Pressable around a 32 chip.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Button `md`, search field, Player prev/next.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Button `lg`, stepper `lg` hit, AppBar and tab bar height.

tokens.name: size-stepper-button
tokens.usage: Stepper `xl` hit area (invisible; the `surface` circle shows while pressed). Also Button `xl` (Log set) and the Player pause.

tokens.name: size-stepper-xxl
tokens.usage: Stepper `xxl` hit at desktop, glyph 34.

tokens.name: size-stepper-glyph
tokens.usage: The +/- glyph inside the 64 stepper.

tokens.name: size-icon-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, discs, status pills.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Row glyphs, chevrons, meta; the row icon slot is exactly 20 wide.

tokens.name: size-icon-md
tokens.usage: Tabs, buttons, discs, the AppBar `more` glyph.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Empty states.

tokens.name: size-ring-sm
tokens.usage: AppBar eyebrow ring, stroke 3.

tokens.name: size-ring-md
tokens.usage: Card ring, stroke 4.

tokens.name: size-ring-player
tokens.usage: Phone/tablet Player ring, stroke 10.

tokens.name: size-ring-xl
tokens.usage: Desktop Player ring.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: ToggleChip visible height.

tokens.name: size-illustration-sm
tokens.usage: Library and program rows (row height 64, divider inset 84).

tokens.name: size-illustration-md
tokens.usage: Today exercise header at phone/tablet.

tokens.name: size-illustration-lg
tokens.usage: Library detail hero, desktop Today header, Progress detail.

tokens.name: size-illustration-xl
tokens.usage: Reserved desktop hero size.

tokens.name: size-row-min
tokens.usage: ListRow minimum height (text rows); 64 with a 56 thumb.

tokens.name: size-content-max
tokens.usage: Single-column content cap (auth, loading, empty states).

tokens.name: size-control-max
tokens.usage: Desktop cap for a stepper block inside a wide column.

tokens.name: size-page-max
tokens.usage: Desktop page column cap; 1216 at a 1280 window.

tokens.name: size-app-bar-title-slot
tokens.usage: Desktop AppBar: leading + title share this slot so nav links start at one x.

tokens.name: breakpoint-tablet
tokens.usage: Compact below, medium from here: gutter 24.

tokens.name: breakpoint-desktop
tokens.usage: Two columns (7/5, 5/7, 6/6; 6/6 below 1024), tabs hidden, nav in the AppBar.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Only overlays cast a shadow: Banner-as-toast, sheets. Cards are flat.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The dark primary pill's amber glow. Nothing in light.
